```yaml
name: Test vfox crate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # daily

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test on ${{ matrix.os }} with ${{ matrix.rust }} (${{ matrix.features }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        rust: [stable, beta, nightly]
        features: [default, all, no-default]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust ${{ matrix.rust }}
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: ${{ matrix.rust }}
          components: rustfmt,clippy

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}-${{ matrix.rust }}-${{ matrix.features }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}-${{ matrix.rust }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Run tests for vfox
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.features }}" = "default" ]; then
            cargo test -p vfox
          elif [ "${{ matrix.features }}" = "all" ]; then
            cargo test -p vfox --all-features
          else
            cargo test -p vfox --no-default-features
          fi
```
